body:
As my carpool partner took a turn off into the deserted parking lot, I felt an inexplicable draw towards them. The cool autumn air surrounded me as I tried to push aside my curiosity, but my gaze drifted back to their retreating figure every few steps. 

My heart pounded in my chest, racing at the thought of approaching without knowing who they might be or why they left us early. The scent of freshly cut grass mingled with distant traffic—how familiar yet foreign these sensations seemed together.
